content: {"praised":["Story closely follows real Sir Gawain legend.","Costumes and hairstyles are excellent.","Soundtrack is catchy and memorable.","Armor historically accurate and impressive.","Action scenes are great for the time."],"criticized":["Cheesy and absurd costumes, like Sean Connery's green knight.","Dialogue is dreadful and acting atrocious.","Storyline confusing and schizophrenic.","Special effects extremely cheesy and sad portrayal.","Overall film is a mish-mash of clichés." ]}
